acceptanceCriteria: Mixed limits refuse or emit explicitly separated incomparable groups.
Different Corvint binaries cannot produce a merged single-binary claim.
Lexical-first and Corvint-first merges preserve the correct per-arm identity.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, EVAL-01. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: confirmed.

Use --summarize with the same samples digest but a later report produced by a different Corvint binary or limit; overlapping arms replace earlier results. The emitted registration.corvint_sha256, corvint and limit describe the first run although details and aggregate metrics can come from the later run. This breaks benchmark provenance and permits invalid cross-limit paired comparisons. The problem also affects lexical-first merges when the first identity is NOT_RUN.

Source: tools/retrieval-bench/stats.go:368; tools/retrieval-bench/stats.go:391; tools/retrieval-bench/README.md:119

Owning contract/status: "AGENTS.md invariant 1 (immutable evidence); tools/retrieval-bench/README.md Registration and output identity contract. No numbered requirement found governing this merge."

Verification: "GOCACHE=/tmp/corvint-go-build-cache GOTOOLCHAIN=local go run ./tools/retrieval-bench --summarize /tmp/corvint-audit-20260926/evaluation-summary-a.json --summarize /tmp/corvint-audit-20260926/evaluation-summary-b.json --output /tmp/corvint-audit-20260926/evaluation-summary-result.json: exit 0. A used binary a repeated 64 times, limit 5 and old.go; B used binary b repeated 64 times, limit 20 and new.go. Result has new.go but binary a and limit 5. Synthetic report records only; no benchmark cases or held-out evaluation executed."

Suggested correction: Validate compatible limits and sample metadata before merging, and retain explicit per-arm binary/run provenance or reject mixed Corvint binary identities. A lexical-only first report must not supply the identity of later Corvint results.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; retained expert and reproduction evidence in .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Run focused regressions and owning documentation checks; exhaustive gate only when governing release policy requires it. No implementation, intent acceptance or promotion is claimed.

title: Merged retrieval reports attribute later results to the first binary and retrieval limit
